title: MDIT-Bench: Evaluating the Dual-Implicit Toxicity in Large Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on multimodal multiple-choice questions where implicit racism is revealed only by synthesizing text and image modalities, and measuring hidden toxicity via many-shot long-context jailbreaking.
